label: Disabled Auto Available
guidance: Disabled Auto Available. Disables automatic availability behavior. Review staffing/status reset interactions before changing it.

label: Personnel Sort Order
guidance: Personnel Sort Order. Sort order for personnel lists; does not change availability, access or dispatch priority.

label: Personnel List Status Sort Order
guidance: Personnel List Status Sort Order. Custom ordering of personnel statuses in lists. Review all configured statuses before replacing the order.

label: Staffing Suppress Staffing Levels
guidance: Staffing Suppress Staffing Levels. Staffing levels suppressed in supported notifications. Suppression can change who hears an alert and is not evidence of delivery.

label: Personnel List Status Order Setting / Orders
guidance: Personnel List Status Order Setting / Orders. Ordered status weights for supported personnel lists. This does not set availability or dispatch priority.

label: Personnel List Status Order / Weight
guidance: Personnel List Status Order / Weight. Relative list order for this status. Confirm all configured statuses remain represented.

label: Personnel List Status Order / Status ID
guidance: Personnel List Status Order / Status ID. Existing personnel-status identifier whose list position is being configured.

label: Department Suppress Staffing Info / Enable Suppress Staffing
guidance: Department Suppress Staffing Info / Enable Suppress Staffing. Enables the configured staffing-level suppression in supported notification consumers; review reachability before changing it.

label: Department Suppress Staffing Info / Staffing Levels To Suppress
guidance: Department Suppress Staffing Info / Staffing Levels To Suppress. Existing staffing levels to suppress. A suppressed level is not proof that another channel reaches the member.

label: Department / Address ID
guidance: Department / Address ID. Department address reference. Review the owning address and mapping consumers; it is separate from station and site addresses.

label: Test Enabled
guidance: Test Enabled. Department testing behavior. Do not treat enabling a test setting as proof of production readiness.

label: Update Timestamp
guidance: Update Timestamp. Internal configuration timestamp. Read-only metadata, not an administrator-editable preference.

label: Module Settings
guidance: Module Settings. Controls module navigation and supported feature gates. Hiding a module does not delete its records or prove independent dispatch settings are disabled.
source_default: all switches enabled, no label overrides

label: Require2 FAFor Admins
guidance: Require2 FAFor Admins. Administrator MFA requirement mode. Verify actual factors and recovery for each administrator before enforcement changes.

label: Force Chatbot Security Pin
guidance: Force Chatbot Security Pin. Require the member security PIN for sensitive supported chatbot and SMS actions, including members who have not opted in.

label: Require Password Reset Via Email
guidance: Require Password Reset Via Email. Use single-use recovery links for administrator-initiated member password resets, instead of selecting a replacement password.

label: Department Operating Profile
guidance: Department Operating Profile. Declared organization, workforce, dispatch, seasonal, language and policy context. Recommendations never infer licenses or clinical scope from this profile.

label: Operating sectors
guidance: Operating sectors. Choose all sectors served by the department. A pack suggests administrative reviews; it does not establish qualification or clinical scope.

label: Workforce mix
guidance: Workforce mix. Describe the workforce so setup guidance can reflect career, volunteer, contract or combined operations.

label: Declared member count
guidance: Declared member count. Optional planning estimate; actual membership and subscription counts come from their owning sources.

label: Authoritative system references
guidance: Authoritative system references. Short declared source-system labels. Saving this list does not verify a connection, an import or the freshness of external data.

label: Dispatch model
guidance: Dispatch model. Record whether dispatch is central, self-directed, external or a combination. Verify each routing path through its owning settings.

label: Operating hours
guidance: Operating hours. Describe continuous, scheduled, on-call or seasonal operation. This is context and does not create shifts or guarantee coverage.

label: Sites and groups
guidance: Sites and groups. Reference existing numeric group IDs in this department. This does not grant group access or change dispatch scope.

label: Mutual aid participation
guidance: Mutual aid participation. Declare whether mutual aid is part of operations. Agreements, access and response eligibility require separate review.

label: Working languages
guidance: Working languages. Languages used by the team. This preference does not prove interpreter availability or translate operational records.

label: Accessibility preferences
guidance: Accessibility preferences. Record screen-reader, caption, large-text or plain-language needs for setup planning. Verify client behavior with the people who use it.

label: Staffing policy documents
guidance: Staffing policy documents. Reference existing department document IDs for approved staffing policies. The save checks existence and expiry, not policy approval or adequacy.

label: Qualification policy documents
guidance: Qualification policy documents. Reference existing department document IDs for approved qualification policies. Do not infer a license, scope of practice or deployment qualification from a role label.

label: Continuity procedure documents
guidance: Continuity procedure documents. Reference existing department document IDs for approved continuity procedures. Test fallback communications and ownership through the approved procedure.

label: Season start
guidance: Season start. Start of a declared seasonal period, in MM-DD format. Provide both start and end; this does not enable or disable resources on those dates.

label: Season end
guidance: Season end. End of a declared seasonal period, in MM-DD format. A period can cross a calendar year; verify actual rosters separately.

label: Profile review time
guidance: Profile review time. Server-recorded time of the most recent validated profile save; it does not certify operational readiness.

label: Profile revision
guidance: Profile revision. Server revision used to reject concurrent overwrites. Reload when another administrator has saved a newer profile.

label: Expected email polling interval (minutes)
guidance: Expected email polling interval (minutes). Optional maximum time between recorded mailbox polls, from 1 to 10080 minutes. Blank means no declared polling expectation. This checks configured email connectors, not how often calls arrive; it does not measure SMS, CAD push or API health. Review the host polling schedule before setting it.

label: Create calls
guidance: Create calls. Allows starting a call. The department-level action uses each member’s actual administrator state and personnel roles; later dispatch validation remains authoritative.
source_default: No permission row: everyone; no group lock

label: Create notes
guidance: Create notes. Allows creating a department note. The action does not grant access to protected note contents or another department.
source_default: No permission row: everyone; no group lock

label: View personal information
guidance: View personal information. Controls the personal-information permission gate. Protected fields still require their own current authorization and data protection grant.
source_default: No permission row: everyone; no group lock

label: View personnel
guidance: View personnel. Controls visibility of personnel targets. A group lock can narrow target scope; administrators of a target group or its ancestors use the owning visibility policy.
source_default: No permission row: everyone; no group lock

label: View units
guidance: View units. Controls visibility of unit targets and their assigned stations. Ungrouped viewers and unassigned units do not share a group.
source_default: No permission row: everyone; no group lock

label: View personnel locations
guidance: View personnel locations. Controls the location visibility gate for each viewer and person. The preview counts access pairs, not current map markers, tracking consent or GPS availability.
source_default: No permission row: everyone; no group lock

label: View unit locations
guidance: View unit locations. Controls the location visibility gate for each viewer and unit. A group lock refers to the unit’s station and the owning group hierarchy, not any station a viewer can otherwise see.
source_default: No permission row: everyone; no group lock

label: Department / Department Type
guidance: Department / Department Type. Legacy organization-type label. The operating profile provides multiple sectors; neither establishes clinical scope or response qualifications.

label: Department / Time Zone
guidance: Department / Time Zone. Department time zone used by scheduling and local-date reports. Review overnight shifts and daylight-saving transitions before changing it.

label: Department / Use24 Hour Time
guidance: Department / Use24 Hour Time. Preferred time display. This does not change stored timestamps or the department time zone.

label: Department / Managing User ID
guidance: Department / Managing User ID. Managing-member identity. Subscription and high-risk account operations may require this member; change ownership through its explicit owning workflow.

label: Department / Code
guidance: Department / Code. Department code used by supported identification and access flows. Review those consumers before changing it.

label: Department / API Key
guidance: Department / API Key. Department API credential. Never place it in setup notes or model input; manage and rotate it through the authorized workflow.

label: Department / Public API Key
guidance: Department / Public API Key. Credential used by supported public API consumers. Public in the field name does not make credential disclosure safe.

label: Department / Shared Secret
guidance: Department / Shared Secret. Department integration secret. Rotation can affect integrations and needs coordinated verification.

label: Department / Link Code
guidance: Department / Link Code. Department linking code. Review who can use a link and rotate it using the owning workflow.

label: Department / Show Welcome
guidance: Department / Show Welcome. Legacy welcome flag. Restored setup dismissal is per administrator and does not use this flag as evidence of setup completion.

label: Department Security Policy / Require MFA
guidance: Department Security Policy / Require MFA. Department-wide MFA policy, distinct from the administrator-only setting. Review enrollment, supported factors and recovery before enforcement.

label: Department Security Policy / Require SSO
guidance: Department Security Policy / Require SSO. Requires the supported SSO policy gate. Verify the active identity provider and local recovery arrangements before removing a sign-in path.

label: Department Security Policy / Session Timeout Minutes
guidance: Department Security Policy / Session Timeout Minutes. Idle timeout in minutes; zero defers to host behavior. Verify policy-managed sessions and each supported client rather than assuming immediate global logout.

label: Department Security Policy / Max Concurrent Sessions
guidance: Department Security Policy / Max Concurrent Sessions. Maximum policy-managed concurrent sessions per user; zero means unlimited for this setting. Existing sessions and enforcement rollout must be checked separately.

label: Department Security Policy / Allowed IP Ranges
guidance: Department Security Policy / Allowed IP Ranges. Allowed login network ranges. Empty adds no range restriction. Review legitimate responder networks and recovery access before narrowing it.

label: Department Security Policy / Password Expiration Days
guidance: Department Security Policy / Password Expiration Days. Password age in days; zero disables this policy's age limit. Verify local-password and SSO behavior separately.

label: Department Security Policy / Min Password Length
guidance: Department Security Policy / Min Password Length. Minimum length offered by the policy editor. Actual password validators and supported credential-change paths remain authoritative.

label: Department Security Policy / Require Password Complexity
guidance: Department Security Policy / Require Password Complexity. Stored complexity preference. Consumer and editor coverage must be verified before relying on this field; it is not proof that an existing password meets a rule.

label: Department Security Policy / Data Classification Level
guidance: Department Security Policy / Data Classification Level. Department classification label. Selecting it does not enroll ADP, establish compliance or automatically classify every record correctly.

label: Department Security Policy / Allow Passkeys For Login MFA
guidance: Department Security Policy / Allow Passkeys For Login MFA. Accepts a passkey registered in the requesting app as MFA for sign-in, department entry and step-up. Authenticator codes are always accepted. Changing it advances the MFA policy version; sessions whose only second factor is now disallowed verify again. Managing member only.

label: Department Security Policy / Allow Passkeys For ADP
guidance: Department Security Policy / Allow Passkeys For ADP. Accepts a passkey for protected-data access, ADP management and protected-workflow approvals. Authenticator codes are always accepted. Changing it ends current protected-data access, so members verify again. Managing member only.

label: Department Security Policy / Allow Federated MFA For Login MFA
guidance: Department Security Policy / Allow Federated MFA For Login MFA. Accepts the identity provider's MFA for sign-in and step-up. Requires a tested MFA mapping on the SSO configuration; without one the provider's claims never count. Managing member only.

label: Department Security Policy / Allow Federated MFA For ADP
guidance: Department Security Policy / Allow Federated MFA For ADP. Accepts the identity provider's MFA for protected data. Requires a tested MFA mapping; changing it ends current protected-data access. Managing member only.

label: Department Security Policy / Allow Responder Approval
guidance: Department Security Policy / Allow Responder Approval. Accepts approval with the member's Responder app passkey wherever the matching passkey setting is on; never for security changes or account sign-in methods. Changing it also ends current protected-data access. Managing member only.

label: Department Security Policy / Accept Recent Login MFA For ADP
guidance: Department Security Policy / Accept Recent Login MFA For ADP. Lets MFA completed at sign-in in the same session open protected data within the step-up window, for methods the protected-data settings allow. Changing it ends current protected-data access. Managing member only.

label: Department Security Policy / Accept Recent Unlock MFA For ADP
guidance: Department Security Policy / Accept Recent Unlock MFA For ADP. Lets the operator's fresh unlock verification on a shared device open protected data. Changing it ends current protected-data access. Managing member only.

label: Department Security Policy / Shared Idle Lock Minutes
guidance: Department Security Policy / Shared Idle Lock Minutes. Minutes without operator activity before a shared vehicle tablet or workstation session locks, from 1 to 15. Background updates and incoming alerts are not activity. A stricter value reaches running sessions at their next request. Managing member only.

label: Department Security Policy / Shared Shift Hours
guidance: Department Security Policy / Shared Shift Hours. Hours after sign-in when a shared session ends whatever the activity, from 1 to 24. A shorter value ends running sessions sooner; a longer one never extends them. Managing member only.

label: Department Security Policy / Shared Mode Required Apps
guidance: Department Security Policy / Shared Mode Required Apps. Unit, IC and Dispatch sessions this department always runs as shared sessions, whatever the installation is set to; sign-ins that do not name their app count too. Needs app versions that support shared mode. Managing member only.

label: Department SSO Config / SSO Provider Type
guidance: Department SSO Config / SSO Provider Type. Selects the identity protocol and provider configuration. OIDC and SAML have different metadata, certificates and callback requirements.

label: Department SSO Config / Is Enabled
guidance: Department SSO Config / Is Enabled. Makes this provider configuration available to the supported SSO flow. A saved enabled flag is not a successful sign-in test.

label: Department SSO Config / Client ID
guidance: Department SSO Config / Client ID. Client registration identifier from the identity provider. Keep tenant and audience registration consistent with the owning SSO flow.

label: Department SSO Config / Encrypted Client Secret
guidance: Department SSO Config / Encrypted Client Secret. Encrypted provider client secret. The secret is entered and rotated on the authorized provider editor; Admin Assist only describes its purpose.

label: Department SSO Config / Authority
guidance: Department SSO Config / Authority. OIDC issuer or authority. Verify the intended tenant, discovery metadata and callback registration before enabling it.

label: Department SSO Config / Metadata URL
guidance: Department SSO Config / Metadata URL. SAML provider metadata location. Review the trusted provider and its current signing material through the SSO editor.

label: Department SSO Config / Entity ID
guidance: Department SSO Config / Entity ID. SAML service-provider identifier registered at the identity provider. It must agree with the configured integration.

label: Department SSO Config / Assertion Consumer Service URL
guidance: Department SSO Config / Assertion Consumer Service URL. Stored SAML callback configuration. Use the endpoint supplied by the owning SSO setup and verify the provider registration.

label: Department SSO Config / IdP SSO URL
guidance: Department SSO Config / IdP SSO URL. SAML provider sign-in address that sign-in started from Resgrid sends its request to. Verify it against the provider metadata before relying on it.

label: Department SSO Config / Encrypted IdP Certificate
guidance: Department SSO Config / Encrypted IdP Certificate. Encrypted provider verification certificate material. Review expiry and rotation through SSO; this description is not certificate validation.

label: Department SSO Config / Encrypted Signing Certificate
guidance: Department SSO Config / Encrypted Signing Certificate. Encrypted signing certificate and private-key material. Do not copy it into notes, logs or assistant messages.

label: Department SSO Config / Attribute Mapping JSON
guidance: Department SSO Config / Attribute Mapping JSON. Maps provider attributes to supported member fields. Validate identity matching and missing attributes with an approved test account.

label: Department SSO Config / Federated MFA Mapping JSON
guidance: Department SSO Config / Federated MFA Mapping JSON. Which provider sign-in results count as MFA for provider step-up. A changed mapping, issuer or client needs a new successful test before provider MFA is accepted again.

label: Department SSO Config / Allow Local Login
guidance: Department SSO Config / Allow Local Login. Allows a local-password path alongside this provider where policy permits. Review the department-wide SSO requirement and recovery plan together.

label: Department SSO Config / Auto Provision Users
guidance: Department SSO Config / Auto Provision Users. Allows the supported sign-in flow to create members. Review identity matching, capacity and default assignments before enabling it.

label: Department SSO Config / Default Rank ID
guidance: Department SSO Config / Default Rank ID. Department rank assigned by supported automatic provisioning. It does not grant permissions or prove qualifications.

label: Department SSO Config / SCIM Enabled
guidance: Department SSO Config / SCIM Enabled. Enables supported SCIM provisioning for this configuration. Review identity lifecycle, deactivation and token access separately from interactive sign-in.

label: Department SSO Config / Encrypted SCIM Bearer Token
guidance: Department SSO Config / Encrypted SCIM Bearer Token. Encrypted credential for inbound SCIM requests. Rotate through the explicit token workflow and update the provider before retiring an old credential.

label: Units Sort Order
guidance: Units Sort Order. Sort order for unit lists; does not change unit eligibility or dispatch recommendation ranking.

label: Big Board Map Zoom Level
guidance: Big Board Map Zoom Level. Initial Big Board map zoom. An unset override lets the consuming board select its default.

label: Big Board Page Refresh
guidance: Big Board Page Refresh. Big Board refresh interval. Review load and the age of displayed information before changing it.

label: Big Board Map Center Address
guidance: Big Board Map Center Address. Address used to center the Big Board. Address details remain on their owning screen.

label: Big Board Hide Unavailable
guidance: Big Board Hide Unavailable. Hide unavailable resources on the Big Board; this affects visibility, not their dispatch eligibility.

label: Big Board Map Center Gps Coordinates
guidance: Big Board Map Center Gps Coordinates. Explicit board-center coordinates take precedence over address geocoding. Partial coordinates do not overwrite the saved center.

label: Rss Feed Key For Active Calls
guidance: Rss Feed Key For Active Calls. Credential for the active-call feed. Treat the feed and its key as sensitive; rotate through its owning screen.

label: Text To Call Number
guidance: Text To Call Number. Provisioned inbound text number. Provisioning has external effects and must use the normal text settings flow.

label: Text To Call Import Format
guidance: Text To Call Import Format. Parser used for inbound text call creation. Verify the sender format with a controlled example on the owning screen.

label: Text To Call Source Numbers
guidance: Text To Call Source Numbers. Allowed inbound source numbers for text calls and commands. Empty sources prevent accepted intake; never display raw numbers in Admin Assist.

label: Enable Text To Call
guidance: Enable Text To Call. Configured text-call preference. Enforcement differs by provider and chatbot path; the stored value alone does not prove intake is stopped or accepted. Review sender classification and perform an explicit controlled verification on the owning screen.

label: Internal Dispatch Email
guidance: Internal Dispatch Email. Assigned internal dispatch email address. Presence can be shown; the address stays on the authorized import screen.

label: Calls Sort Order
guidance: Calls Sort Order. Sort order for displayed calls; does not reorder provider delivery or change call priority.

label: Dispatch Shift Instead Of Group
guidance: Dispatch Shift Instead Of Group. Expand dispatched groups using the resolved on-duty roster. An empty shift result falls back to group members; preview both cases.

label: Auto Set Status For Shift Dispatch Personnel
guidance: Auto Set Status For Shift Dispatch Personnel. Apply the configured status to shift-dispatched personnel. This only takes effect with shift dispatch enabled.

label: Shift Call Dispatch Personnel Status To Set
guidance: Shift Call Dispatch Personnel Status To Set. Personnel status applied when shift dispatch occurs. Minus one leaves status unchanged; use an existing approved status.

label: Shift Call Release Personnel Status To Set
guidance: Shift Call Release Personnel Status To Set. Personnel status applied on call release for the shift-dispatch path. Minus one leaves status unchanged.

label: Unit Dispatch Also Dispatch To Assigned Personnel
guidance: Unit Dispatch Also Dispatch To Assigned Personnel. Expand unit dispatch to its assigned crew. Review duplicate routes, current assignments and recipient permissions.

label: Unit Dispatch Also Dispatch To Group
guidance: Unit Dispatch Also Dispatch To Group. Expand unit dispatch to the station group. This can substantially increase the recipient audience.

label: Check In Timers Auto Enable For New Calls
guidance: Check In Timers Auto Enable For New Calls. Automatically start configured check-in timers for new calls. Review timer targets and escalation before enabling it.

label: Unit Call Dispatch Status To Set
guidance: Unit Call Dispatch Status To Set. Unit status applied during call dispatch. Minus one or an invalid built-in unit status leaves the status unchanged.

label: Unit Call Release Status To Set
guidance: Unit Call Release Status To Set. Unit status applied at call release. Review unit-type overrides before assuming one department-wide effect.

label: Unit Call Status Overrides By Unit Type
guidance: Unit Call Status Overrides By Unit Type. Per-unit-type call status overrides. Existing type-specific values take precedence over department defaults.

label: Dispatch Recommendation Mode
guidance: Dispatch Recommendation Mode. Dispatch recommendation selection mode. Review run cards, eligible resources and human dispatch responsibility.

label: Dispatch Recommendation Auto Dispatch
guidance: Dispatch Recommendation Auto Dispatch. Allow the recommendation path to dispatch automatically where enabled. Preview recipients and verify local procedures first.

label: Dispatch Recommendation Config
guidance: Dispatch Recommendation Config. Location, ETA, rest, crew and move-up settings used by recommendation consumers. External ETA calls occur only in the owning operational flow.

label: New Call Field Policy
guidance: New Call Field Policy. Controls optional new-call fields across supported clients. Hidden fields cannot be required; core dispatch fields remain mandatory.

label: Group Dispatch Scope Config
guidance: Group Dispatch Scope Config. Group-subtree dispatch visibility with explicit role exceptions. Preview each actor and target scope before changing it.

label: Unit Type Call Status Override Setting / Overrides
guidance: Unit Type Call Status Override Setting / Overrides. Per-unit-type dispatch and release status overrides. The owning consumer resolves these before department defaults.

label: Unit Type Call Status Override / Unit Type ID
guidance: Unit Type Call Status Override / Unit Type ID. Existing unit type receiving this override. A unit type name is not a qualification or staffing clearance.

label: Unit Type Call Status Override / Dispatch Status
guidance: Unit Type Call Status Override / Dispatch Status. Status applied to this unit type on dispatch; minus one leaves it unchanged.

label: Unit Type Call Status Override / Release Status
guidance: Unit Type Call Status Override / Release Status. Status applied to this unit type on release; minus one leaves it unchanged.

label: New Call Field Policy / Rules
guidance: New Call Field Policy / Rules. Per-field visibility and requiredness for optional call-creation fields. Unconfigured fields remain visible and optional.

label: New Call Field Rule / Key
guidance: New Call Field Rule / Key. One supported built-in call-field key. Name, nature, priority and type cannot be removed through this policy.

label: New Call Field Rule / Visible
guidance: New Call Field Rule / Visible. Whether the optional call field is shown on supported creation surfaces. Hidden fields cannot be required.

label: New Call Field Rule / Required
guidance: New Call Field Rule / Required. Whether a visible optional field must be supplied. Review imports and each supported client before making a field mandatory.

label: Group Dispatch Scope Config / Enabled
guidance: Group Dispatch Scope Config / Enabled. Limit supported dispatch views to the member's group subtree. Department administrators and configured department-wide roles keep department-wide access.

label: Group Dispatch Scope Config / Department Wide Role IDs
guidance: Group Dispatch Scope Config / Department Wide Role IDs. Existing roles allowed department-wide dispatch views while group scoping is enabled. This changes view scope, not licensing or operational qualification.

label: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Max Location Age Seconds
guidance: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Max Location Age Seconds. Exclude older unit positions from closest-unit candidates; zero removes the age limit. IncludeStaleLocations changes this behavior.

label: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Max Radius Meters
guidance: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Max Radius Meters. Maximum candidate distance in meters; zero removes the radius cap. This is not a response-time or route-safety guarantee.

label: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Include Stale Locations
guidance: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Include Stale Locations. Permit positions beyond the configured age limit in closest-unit selection, marked stale. Review the risk of outdated positions.

label: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Personnel Max Location Age Seconds
guidance: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Personnel Max Location Age Seconds. Maximum age of personnel positions for closest-unit candidate selection; zero removes the age limit.

label: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Use Routed ETA
guidance: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Use Routed ETA. Re-rank shortlisted candidates using provider travel estimates. The operational path can make external provider calls; Admin Assist does not.

label: Dispatch Recommendation Config / ETA Shortlist Size
guidance: Dispatch Recommendation Config / ETA Shortlist Size. Number of straight-line candidates per requirement sent for routed ETA when enabled. The owning validator caps provider work.

label: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Rest Period Minutes
guidance: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Rest Period Minutes. Deprioritize recently dispatched resources for this duration; zero disables rotation. This does not infer fatigue or medical fitness.

label: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Unit Minimum Staffing Level
guidance: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Unit Minimum Staffing Level. Minimum configured unit staffing level for recommendation eligibility; zero disables the gate. Units without defined seats pass, and run cards may override it.

label: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Move Up Recommendations Enabled
guidance: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Move Up Recommendations Enabled. Run the station coverage move-up pass after selection. Recommendations remain subject to approved local dispatch procedures.

label: Department Call Email / Hostname
guidance: Department Call Email / Hostname. Mailbox host for email intake. Review the approved provider and network reachability without exposing credentials in setup guidance.

label: Department Call Email / Port
guidance: Department Call Email / Port. Mailbox connection port. It must match the selected provider and TLS mode.

label: Department Call Email / Use SSL
guidance: Department Call Email / Use SSL. Mailbox transport encryption option. Verify actual provider compatibility and successful polling; a stored flag alone does not prove transport protection.

label: Department Call Email / Username
guidance: Department Call Email / Username. Mailbox account identifier used for intake. It remains on the authorized configuration screen.

label: Department Call Email / Password
guidance: Department Call Email / Password. Mailbox credential. Do not copy it into Admin Assist; rotate it through the mailbox and owning editor together.

label: Department Call Email / Format Type
guidance: Department Call Email / Format Type. Selects the inbound email parser. Verify representative permitted source messages without sending an operational page unintentionally.

label: Department Call Email / Last Check
guidance: Department Call Email / Last Check. Last recorded polling timestamp. Missing or future timestamps are unknown; quiet call volume is not proof of a poll failure.

label: Department Call Email / Is Failure
guidance: Department Call Email / Is Failure. Latest recorded mailbox failure flag. Verify a new poll before treating it as a continuing outage or a resolved problem.

label: Department Call Email / Error Message
guidance: Department Call Email / Error Message. Provider/import error details on the authorized screen. Admin Assist uses a normalized failure indication and does not copy provider bodies.

label: Personnel On Unit Set Unit Status
guidance: Personnel On Unit Set Unit Status. Allow personnel status updates to influence their assigned unit status. Review automation and crew assignment together.

label: Enable Text Command
guidance: Enable Text Command. Configured text-command preference. Dispatch-source patterns and verified member command identity are different checks. Provider and chatbot paths do not enforce this switch uniformly; review the active consumer before changing it.

label: Tts Language
guidance: Tts Language. Text-to-speech language for supported voice notifications. Confirm supported voices and pronunciation with a human-run test.

label: Enable Modern Notifications
guidance: Enable Modern Notifications. Use supported modern notification behavior. Verify each consumer and channel; provider acceptance is not delivery.

label: Messaging availability
guidance: Messaging availability. Controls availability of messages and announcements. Disabling this module can remove navigation and block module operations; it does not delete its records. Turning it on still requires the applicable subscription, rollout and permissions.

label: Messaging menu name
guidance: Messaging menu name. Optional display name for messages and announcements in consumers that support the override. It changes the label, not permissions or functionality. This release has no separate name-override control in Module Settings.

label: Department Notification / Event Type
guidance: Department Notification / Event Type. Event that can trigger this notification rule. Match the event to a real administrative responsibility and expected frequency.

label: Department Notification / Users To Notify
guidance: Department Notification / Users To Notify. Explicit member recipients. Membership and channel eligibility are evaluated separately at send time.

label: Department Notification / Roles To Notify
guidance: Department Notification / Roles To Notify. Personnel-role recipients. Role membership can change; a role label is not a qualification or delivery guarantee.

label: Department Notification / Groups To Notify
guidance: Department Notification / Groups To Notify. Department-group recipients. Review group membership and lock-to-group behavior together.

label: Department Notification / Lock To Group
guidance: Department Notification / Lock To Group. Restricts applicable event processing to group scope. Review the selected event's actual source group and recipient resolver.

label: Department Notification / Selected Groups Admins Only
guidance: Department Notification / Selected Groups Admins Only. Limits selected-group recipients to their administrators in supported event paths. It does not designate department administrators automatically.

label: Department Notification / Department Admins
guidance: Department Notification / Department Admins. Includes department administrators in supported notification processing. Review overlap and channel eligibility before estimating volume.

label: Department Notification / Everyone
guidance: Department Notification / Everyone. Selects the department-wide recipient option. Review actual active membership, suppression and deduplication before use.

label: Department Notification / Disabled
guidance: Department Notification / Disabled. Stored disabled marker. The inspected legacy notification processor does not consult this flag, so it must not be treated as a verified stop switch. Review the active consumer; queued and delivered notifications cannot be recalled.

label: Department Notification / Before Data
guidance: Department Notification / Before Data. Previous-state filter for applicable events. Review valid status IDs and the event-specific interpretation of an empty or wildcard value.

label: Department Notification / Current Data
guidance: Department Notification / Current Data. Current-state filter for applicable events. Compare it with the previous-state filter to avoid unintended volume.

label: Department Notification / Upper Limit
guidance: Department Notification / Upper Limit. Upper threshold for event-specific alerts. Units and comparisons depend on the selected event.

label: Department Notification / Lower Limit
guidance: Department Notification / Lower Limit. Lower threshold for event-specific alerts. Use approved local thresholds and verify the actual event interpretation.

label: Department Notification / Data
guidance: Department Notification / Data. Event-specific configuration payload. The owning editor validates its meaning; Admin Assist does not execute arbitrary stored expressions.

label: Chatbot Department Config / Is Enabled
guidance: Chatbot Department Config / Is Enabled. Department chatbot availability. Platform feature rollout, account linking and action permissions are separate gates.

label: Chatbot Department Config / Allowed Platforms
guidance: Chatbot Department Config / Allowed Platforms. Allowed chatbot platform codes; the stored asterisk represents the platform default. Review each connected provider and its account-linking requirements.

label: Chatbot Department Config / Max Sessions Per User
guidance: Chatbot Department Config / Max Sessions Per User. Maximum chatbot sessions per member in supported consumers. This is separate from authenticated web/mobile session limits.

label: Chatbot Department Config / Session TTL Minutes
guidance: Chatbot Department Config / Session TTL Minutes. Chatbot session lifetime in minutes. Expiry does not revoke an unrelated Resgrid sign-in session.

label: Chatbot Department Config / Allow Dispatch Via Chatbot
guidance: Chatbot Department Config / Allow Dispatch Via Chatbot. Permits supported chatbot dispatch actions subject to their own authorization and confirmation. Enabling it may allow real calls and pages.

label: Chatbot Department Config / Require Confirmation For Status Change
guidance: Chatbot Department Config / Require Confirmation For Status Change. Requests confirmation for supported status changes. Review each platform consumer before assuming all commands are covered.

label: Chatbot Department Config / LLM API Endpoint
guidance: Chatbot Department Config / LLM API Endpoint. Optional existing chatbot model endpoint. Phase 0 Admin Assist does not call it and does not use chatbot configuration as an AI entitlement.

label: Chatbot Department Config / LLM API Key
guidance: Chatbot Department Config / LLM API Key. Credential for the chatbot model provider. Never copy it into setup metadata or public reference content.

label: Chatbot Department Config / LLM Model Name
guidance: Chatbot Department Config / LLM Model Name. Model identifier used by the existing chatbot integration. This is separate from the later Admin Assist open-source inference deployment.

label: Chatbot Department Config / Messages Per User Per Minute
guidance: Chatbot Department Config / Messages Per User Per Minute. Optional per-member chatbot rate bound. Review provider limits and burst behavior; this is not a delivery guarantee.

label: Chatbot Department Config / Messages Per Department Per Minute
guidance: Chatbot Department Config / Messages Per Department Per Minute. Optional department chatbot rate bound. Consider shared demand and provider quotas before changing it.

label: Chatbot Department Config / Require Linking Confirmation
guidance: Chatbot Department Config / Require Linking Confirmation. Requires confirmation in the supported account-linking flow. Linking must not bypass verified identity or departmental authorization.

label: Chatbot Department Config / Proactive Notifications Enabled
guidance: Chatbot Department Config / Proactive Notifications Enabled. Allows supported proactive chatbot notifications. Recipient permissions, channel configuration and sending workflows remain authoritative.

label: Mapping Personnel Location TTL
guidance: Mapping Personnel Location TTL. Maximum personnel location age in minutes. Zero keeps stale positions visible without an age limit; assess actual ping ages.

label: Mapping Unit Location TTL
guidance: Mapping Unit Location TTL. Maximum unit location age in minutes. Zero retains stale unit locations indefinitely in supported map consumers.

label: Mapping Personnel Allow Status With No Location To Overwrite
guidance: Mapping Personnel Allow Status With No Location To Overwrite. Allow a personnel status without a location to replace the previous location-bearing state. This can remove a marker.

label: Mapping Unit Allow Status With No Location To Overwrite
guidance: Mapping Unit Allow Status With No Location To Overwrite. Allow a unit status without a location to overwrite earlier location data. Check hardware and app updates together.

label: Weather Alerts Enabled
guidance: Weather Alerts Enabled. Enable supported weather-alert processing. Configure zones and communication behavior before relying on it.

label: Weather Alert Minimum Severity
guidance: Weather Alert Minimum Severity. Minimum severity eligible for the weather-alert view. Severity values come from the weather service, not local incident triage.

label: Weather Alert Auto Message Severity
guidance: Weather Alert Auto Message Severity. Minimum weather severity eligible for automatic messages. Review recipients, schedule and duplicate suppression.

label: Weather Alert Call Integration
guidance: Weather Alert Call Integration. Include supported weather context in call integration. It does not certify weather or route safety.

label: Weather Alert Cache Minutes
guidance: Weather Alert Cache Minutes. Weather cache duration; longer caching changes freshness and provider load.

label: Weather Alert Auto Message Schedule
guidance: Weather Alert Auto Message Schedule. Schedule for automatic weather messaging. Review the department time zone, overnight periods and daylight-saving changes.

label: Weather Alert Excluded Events
guidance: Weather Alert Excluded Events. Weather event types excluded from configured processing. Review exclusions against approved local procedures.

label: Mapping Use Mapbox Override
guidance: Mapping Use Mapbox Override. Use the department map provider override. Turning it off on the owning screen removes the stored style and token.

label: Mapping Mapbox Style Url
guidance: Mapping Mapbox Style Url. Custom map style reference. Verify the provider style and credential together; disabling the override deletes this value.

label: Mapping Mapbox Access Token
guidance: Mapping Mapbox Access Token. Map-provider access token. Only presence is reported. Disabling the override deletes it and requires re-entry to restore.

label: Hardware Tracking Stale After Seconds
guidance: Hardware Tracking Stale After Seconds. Age at which a hardware location becomes stale, clamped to at least one second. Review device reporting intervals.

label: Hardware Tracking Mobile Fallback Enabled
guidance: Hardware Tracking Mobile Fallback Enabled. Use supported mobile location fallback when hardware data is stale. Verify each device/source rather than assuming continuous tracking.

label: Hardware Tracking Location Retention Days
guidance: Hardware Tracking Location Retention Days. Tracking retention bounded by host configuration and applicable holds. Shortening retention can make data eligible for deletion.

label: Unit Status Thresholds
guidance: Unit Status Thresholds. Visual warning thresholds for time in a unit status. A highlight does not change the unit status or certify availability.

label: Mapping availability
guidance: Mapping availability. Controls availability of maps and location views. Disabling this module can remove navigation and block module operations; it does not delete its records. Turning it on still requires the applicable subscription, rollout and permissions.

label: Mapping menu name
guidance: Mapping menu name. Optional display name for maps and location views in consumers that support the override. It changes the label, not permissions or functionality. This release has no separate name-override control in Module Settings.

label: Unit Status Thresholds / Thresholds
guidance: Unit Status Thresholds / Thresholds. Board highlighting thresholds grouped by base status meaning. An empty list disables highlighting.

label: Unit Status Threshold / Base Type
guidance: Unit Status Threshold / Base Type. Base status meaning for a threshold, independent of custom status names and colors.

label: Unit Status Threshold / Warn Seconds
guidance: Unit Status Threshold / Warn Seconds. Seconds in this status before a warning highlight; zero disables it. An alert at or before this threshold makes the row alert-only.

label: Unit Status Threshold / Alert Seconds
guidance: Unit Status Threshold / Alert Seconds. Seconds in this status before a higher-priority highlight; zero disables it. Highlighting does not send a page or change status.

label: Weather Alert Zone / Name
guidance: Weather Alert Zone / Name. Administrator-facing label for this weather zone. The name does not define its geographic coverage.

label: Weather Alert Zone / Zone Code
guidance: Weather Alert Zone / Zone Code. Provider weather-zone identifier. Verify the intended jurisdiction and source coverage.

label: Weather Alert Zone / Center Geo Location
guidance: Weather Alert Zone / Center Geo Location. Center point used by supported radius-based weather coverage. Coordinate values stay on their owning map/editor.

label: Weather Alert Zone / Radius Miles
guidance: Weather Alert Zone / Radius Miles. Radius in miles for supported geographic matching. Review actual coverage and provider behavior; larger is not automatically safer.

label: Weather Alert Zone / Is Active
guidance: Weather Alert Zone / Is Active. Whether the zone participates in supported weather processing. Department weather settings and worker operation are additional requirements.

label: Weather Alert Zone / Is Primary
guidance: Weather Alert Zone / Is Primary. Marks the primary zone for consumers that select a default. Review other active zones rather than assuming they are disabled.

label: Allow Signups For Multiple Shift Groups
guidance: Allow Signups For Multiple Shift Groups. Allow a member to sign up for multiple shift groups. Review overlaps and local coverage rules separately.

label: Shifts availability
